detail.body:
## Overview

ROCm support for [stepfun-ai/Step-5-Preview](https://huggingface.co/stepfun-ai/Step-5-Preview), complementing the NVIDIA support added in #61727. This PR adds a self-contained amd/ implementation under vllm/models/step5/ and moves the platform-independent Step-5 sparse-attention code from nvidia/ to common/.

The primary support and validation target is **MI300X/MI325X (gfx942)**. **MI355X (gfx950)** is also supported and has secondary validation from [@jamesETsmith](https://github.com/jamesETsmith).

## Claims

- Step-5-Preview FP8 weights serve at TP8 on ROCm with text and image input.
- Compressed sparse attention (CSA) runs on the 23 sparse layers for prefill, chunked prefill, decode, and MTP verification.
- The main paged K/V cache uses ROCm AITER unified attention. The sparse summary cache, speculative tail ring, region scoring, and split-K decode code are shared with the NVIDIA Step-5 path.
- Sparse layers support the default BF16 K/V cache and FP8 E4M3 K/V. FP8 K/V requires `--block-size 32`.
- Three-token MTP works through the Step-3.5 MTP proposer with comparable accuracy and about 2.3x speedup in the earlier GSM8K run.
- Prefix caching and P/D disaggregation are supported. NIXL and Mooncake keep compressed summary pages whole and reject unsupported page splitting.
- CSA uses the existing KV-cache lifecycle and does not require scheduler changes or GPU-to-CPU synchronization.

### Serving command (ROCm, MTP enabled)

<details>
<summary>Serve Step-5-Preview on 8x MI300X</summary>

```bash
VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1 vllm serve stepfun-ai/Step-5-Preview \
  --tensor-parallel-size 8 \
  --max-model-len 32768 \
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.90 \
  --moe-backend triton \
  --mm-encoder-attn-backend ROCM_AITER_FA \
  --mm-encoder-tp-mode data \
  --mm-processor-cache-type shm \
  --limit-mm-per-prompt '{"image":1,"video":0}' \
  --reasoning-parser step5 \
  --tool-call-parser step5 \
  --enable-auto-tool-choice \
  --speculative-config '{"method":"mtp","num_speculative_tokens":3}'
```

| Flag | Why |
|---|---|
| `--moe-backend triton` | Required. Every MoE layer clamps SwiGLU at 7, and AITER's block-FP8 MoE does not apply that clamp yet. |
| `--mm-encoder-*`, `--limit-mm-per-prompt` | Image input through the perception-encoder tower. |
| Default K/V dtype | BF16 sparse K/V. |
| `--kv-cache-dtype fp8 --block-size 32` | Optional FP8 E4M3 sparse K/V. |

</details>

### How this fits with #61727

| | #61727 (NVIDIA) | This PR (ROCm) |
|---|---|---|
| Platforms | SM90, SM103 | gfx942 primary; gfx950 secondary |
| Main paged attention | NVIDIA backends | ROCm AITER unified attention |
| Sparse state | Summary cache + speculative tail ring | Same cache contracts |
| Region scoring / decode | Triton and FlashInfer adapters | Shared Triton scoring and split-K decode |
| Indexer Q/W | Sharded by provider group | Sharded by provider group |
| MTP | Yes | Yes, through the Step-3.5 MTP proposer |
| Parsers | `step5` | `step5` |

Like nvidia/, amd/ imports nothing from the other platform and does not use or change model_executor/models/step3p5*; nvidia/ changes are import paths only.

## Validation

### Primary: gfx942

**Model setup:** 8x MI300X, TP8, `max-model-len 32768`, vLLM ROCm nightly `3f1bcfd82` with this branch applied.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| GSM8K, full 1319, 5-shot chat (earlier revision) | 97.2%; 97.4% with MTP |
| GSM8K, 200-question sample, MTP (final model revision) | 96.0% |
| Needle in a haystack, 4K / 16K / 30K, 3 depths, 3 trials | 27/27 |
| Image input: shapes, counting, reading text | 3/3 correct |
| Prefix caching, shared ~22K-token prefix | 66% of prompt tokens from cache; answers correct |
| MTP acceptance, 3 draft tokens (earlier revision) | Mean acceptance length 3.1 to 3.3 |
| `VLLM_GPU_SYNC_CHECK=error`, long chunked prefill + 15 concurrent decodes | No syncs |
| Prefill, 26K-token prompt | TTFT 2.7 s |
| `step5` parsers, stream and non-stream | Pass |
| `tests/models/test_initialization.py` | Pass |

The latest focused tests were also run on MI325X (gfx942). They cover gated four-token MTP verification, short-history decode, true nonzero-offset chunked prefill, equal-length prefill versus decode metadata, scored-prefill warmup discovery, and compressed-page checks through the real NIXL and Mooncake connector constructors.

### Secondary: gfx950

Validation by [@jamesETsmith](https://github.com/jamesETsmith):

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| GSM8K, 5-shot, 1319 | 96.97% strict / 97.27% flexible; 96.59% / 97.04% with MTP |
| GPQA-Diamond, 198-question, zero-shot CoT | 85.86% (170/198); 85.35% (169/198) with MTP, raw lower bounds with a 16K generation budget |
| RULER-style single-key and multikey-2/3 NIAH | 100% at 32K / 128K / 256K, with and without MTP |

The focused CSA and connector tests also passed on MI355X (gfx950). Full validation details are in [James's comment](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/61837#issuecomment-6206831125).

About 8% of GSM8K items timed out in lm-eval's client at concurrency 64 because of long reasoning traces. They were re-asked with the same settings and scored with lm-eval's strict regex. Raw lm-eval scores were 89.2% for CSA and 88.7% for CSA + MTP.

#### In-tree reorganization (latest commit)

Same session, 8x MI300X, TP8, median TPOT (ms) over 3 runs, before vs after the reorganization:

| K/V | 1K in, 1 req | 8K in, 1 req | 1K in, 16 conc |
|---|---|---|---|
| BF16 | 38.97 / 39.42 | 86.67 / 87.01 | 45.10 / 44.80 |
| FP8 E4M3, `--block-size 32` | 39.41 / 39.32 | 91.96 / 91.90 | 44.85 / 45.66 |

Raw lm-eval GSM8K is unchanged (89.4% before; 89.4% BF16 K/V and 89.2% FP8 K/V after), and the real checkpoint loads the same tensors and values. The scored-prefill warmup cuts the first cold 9K-token prompt from 3.46 s to 1.14 s.

The same comparison on 8x MI350X (gfx950), BF16 K/V:

| | 1K in, 1 req | 8K in, 1 req | 1K in, 16 conc | GSM8K raw (flexible / strict) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Before | 24.83 | 79.10 | 32.18 | 89.9% / 89.7% |
| After | 24.83 | 79.17 | 32.32 | 89.1% / 88.6% |

The GSM8K gap is within one standard error (±0.86) and matches the extra client timeouts on long reasoning traces (101 before, 110 after).

The 600B checkpoint does not fit in CI, so model-level results come from real hardware. The focused kernel, metadata, configuration, warmup, and connector tests are CI-sized.

## Details

- **Layout:** `vllm/models/step5/{common,nvidia,amd}` with platform dispatch from `vllm/models/step5/__init__.py`. ROCm code lives only in `amd/`
- **Main K/V:** written by `unified_kv_cache_update` and consumed directly from the AITER unified paged layout.
- **Sparse state:** an FP8 summary cache plus a tail ring for incomplete and speculative regions, both attached to the existing KV-cache lifecycle.
- **Decode and MTP:** summary scoring, per-row top-k, and split-K paged attention support ordinary decode and four-row MTP verification, including the head-wise attention gate.
- **Scored prefill:** histories longer than `topk * region_size` use packed summary scoring. Startup warmup now covers this path  on ROCm it dispatches to `amd/warmup.py`
- **Indexer sharding:** Q and W are `ColumnParallelLinear` sharded by provider group; K and Z stay replicated.
- **P/D:** NIXL and Mooncake preserve compressed pages for compatible layouts and fail early if a layer-outer transfer would split one compressed state page. This check applies to every compressed-cache model.
- **MoE:** the shared expert runs inside FusedMoE, and the combined output is all-reduced once in the model dtype.
- **Graphs:** the CSA op is a graph-splitting op and uses real per-step metadata. Piecewise CUDA graphs are supported.

### Limitations

| Limitation | Follow-up |
|---|---|
| Piecewise CUDA graphs only | Make CSA metadata safe for full graphs |
| `--moe-backend triton` required | Add the post-SiLU clamp to AITER block-FP8 MoE |
| Sparse top-k still has unfused work | Fuse and optimize region selection |

---

<details>
<summary> Pull Request Checklist </summary>

- [x] I used vLLM's PR checklist.
- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation and review of this PR.
- [x] This is the ROCm counterpart to #61727, not a duplicate implementation for the same platform.
- [x] **Design Fit:** Reuses the existing KV-cache lifecycle and shared Step-5 sparse components without scheduler changes.
- [x] **Testing and Validation:** Covers BF16/FP8 K/V, prefill, chunked prefill, decode, MTP, the head-wise gate, warmup, and connector page geometry, with model validation on real gfx942 and gfx950 hardware.
- [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps the platform-specific model code under `amd/` and shares platform-independent code through `common/`
- [x] **Pull Request Contents:** Documents the current implementation, commands, limitations, and validation results.

</details>

+"""Step-5 CSA per-step metadata on ROCm."""
+
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from tests.v1.attention.utils import BatchSpec, create_common_attn_metadata
+from vllm.models.step5.amd.csa_cache import Step5CSAMetadataBuilder
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+REGION = 8
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not current_platform.is_rocm(), reason="Step5 CSA metadata is the ROCm path"
+)
+
+
+def _builder(num_speculative_tokens: int | None = None) -> Step5CSAMetadataBuilder:
+    config = SimpleNamespace(
+        model_config=SimpleNamespace(
+            hf_text_config=SimpleNamespace(
+                sparse_config=SimpleNamespace(region_block_size=REGION, topk=512)
+            )
+        ),
+        scheduler_config=SimpleNamespace(max_num_batched_tokens=64),
+        speculative_config=(
+            None
+            if num_speculative_tokens is None
+            else SimpleNamespace(num_speculative_tokens=num_speculative_tokens)
+        ),
+    )
+    return Step5CSAMetadataBuilder(SimpleNamespace(), [], config, torch.device("cuda"))
+
+
+def test_builder_positions_fallback():
+    """Spec-decode metadata carries no positions; the builder must derive them."""
+    spec = BatchSpec(seq_lens=[40, 9, 130], query_lens=[4, 9, 1])
+    m = create_common_attn_metadata(spec, block_size=16, device=torch.device("cuda"))
+    assert m.positions is None
+    builder = _builder()
+    md = builder.build(0, m)
+    assert md.positions is not None and md.token_req is not None
+
+    want_pos = [
+        p for s, q in zip(spec.seq_lens, spec.query_lens) for p in range(s - q, s)
+    ]
+    want_req = [r for r, q in enumerate(spec.query_lens) for _ in range(q)]
+    assert md.positions.tolist() == want_pos
+    assert md.token_req.tolist() == want_req
+
+
+def test_builder_plans_prefill_only_for_decode_or_mtp_verify():
+    """Equal-length prefills are not mistaken for decode or MTP verification."""
+    prefill = BatchSpec(seq_lens=[9, 9], query_lens=[9, 9])
+    md = _builder().build(
+        0, create_common_attn_metadata(prefill, 16, device=torch.device("cuda"))
+    )
+    assert md.prefill_groups is not None and md.prefill_groups.shape == (18, 10)
+
+    decode = BatchSpec(seq_lens=[40, 9, 130], query_lens=[1, 1, 1])
+    md = _builder().build(
+        0, create_common_attn_metadata(decode, 16, device=torch.device("cuda"))
+    )
+    assert md.prefill_groups is None
+
+    mtp = BatchSpec(seq_lens=[40, 9, 130], query_lens=[4, 4, 4])
+    md = _builder(num_speculative_tokens=3).build(
+        0, create_common_attn_metadata(mtp, 16, device=torch.device("cuda"))
+    )
+    assert md.prefill_groups is None

+    md = _builder().build(
+        0, create_common_attn_metadata(mixed, 16, device=torch.device("cuda"))
+    )

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Paged Step-5 CSA kernels vs PyTorch references on scrambled block tables.
+
+Each test mixes requests with their own block-table rows, and prefill, chunked
+prefill and decode rows, since a page- or request-addressing bug reads wrong
+tokens without changing any shape.
+"""
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from vllm.models.step5.amd.ops.csa_paged import sparse_attention_paged
+from vllm.models.step5.common.ops.sparse_decode_attention import (
+    sparse_decode_attention,
+)
+from vllm.models.step5.common.ops.sparse_indexer import select_regions
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not current_platform.is_rocm(), reason="Step5 CSA kernels are the ROCm path"
+)
+
+DEVICE = "cuda"
+REGION = 8
+PROXY = 256
+
+
+def _paged(
+    seqs: list[torch.Tensor], rows_per_page: int
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """Scatter each request's rows into shared pages behind its own row of a
+    shuffled ``[requests, pages]`` block table."""
+    pages = [-(-x.shape[0] // rows_per_page) for x in seqs]
+    perm = torch.randperm(sum(pages) + 3, device=DEVICE).int()
+    table = torch.zeros(len(seqs), max(pages), dtype=torch.int32, device=DEVICE)
+    cache = torch.zeros(
+        (sum(pages) + 3, rows_per_page, *seqs[0].shape[1:]),
+        dtype=seqs[0].dtype,
+        device=DEVICE,
+    )
+    start = 0
+    for r, (x, n) in enumerate(zip(seqs, pages)):
+        table[r, :n] = perm[start : start + n]
+        start += n
+        idx = torch.arange(x.shape[0], device=DEVICE)
+        cache[table[r, idx // rows_per_page].long(), idx % rows_per_page] = x
+    return cache, table
+
+
+def ref_select(scores: torch.Tensor, positions: torch.Tensor, topk: int):
+    tokens, groups, _ = scores.shape
+    out = torch.full((tokens, groups, topk + 1), -1, dtype=torch.int32)
+    for t in range(tokens):
+        own = int(positions[t]) // REGION
+        for g in range(groups):
+            order = torch.argsort(-scores[t, g, :own].cpu(), stable=True)[:topk]
+            row = torch.cat([torch.sort(order).values, torch.tensor([own])])
+            out[t, g, -row.numel() :] = row.to(torch.int32)
+    return out
+
+
+def ref_attention(q, k, v, regions, req, positions, scale):
+    tokens, heads, _ = q.shape
+    groups = k.shape[2]
+    per_group = heads // groups
+    out = torch.zeros(q.shape, dtype=torch.float32)
+    for t in range(tokens):
+        kr, vr = k[int(req[t])], v[int(req[t])]
+        for g in range(groups):
+            ids = regions[t, g]
+            ids = ids[ids >= 0].long().cpu()
+            cols = (ids[:, None] * REGION + torch.arange(REGION)).flatten()
+            cols = cols[cols <= int(positions[t])]
+            hs = slice(g * per_group, (g + 1) * per_group)
+            p = torch.softmax(
+                q[t, hs].float().cpu() @ kr[cols, g].float().cpu().T * scale, -1
+            )
+            out[t, hs] = p @ vr[cols, g].float().cpu()
+    return out
+
+
+def test_select_regions_breaks_ties_by_region_id():
+    """Post-ReLU scores are often exactly zero; ties must pick lower ids."""
+    torch.manual_seed(0)
+    scores = torch.randn(48, 2, 40, device=DEVICE)
+    scores[scores.abs() < 0.5] = 0.0
+    positions = torch.randint(0, 40 * REGION, (48,), device=DEVICE)
+    own = (positions // REGION).repeat_interleave(2)
+    got = select_regions(scores.flatten(0, 1), own, 6, "per_row").view(48, 2, -1)
+    want = ref_select(scores, positions, 6)
+    for g, w in zip(got.cpu(), want):
+        for gg, ww in zip(g, w):
+            assert sorted(gg[gg >= 0].tolist()) == sorted(ww[ww >= 0].tolist())
+
+
+FP8_KV = [None, torch.float8_e4m3fn, torch.float8_e4m3fnuz]
+
+
+def _quant_kv(k, v, kv_dtype):
+    """KV as stored (FP8 with per-tensor scales, or BF16) and as the reference
+    sees it."""
+    if kv_dtype is None:
+        return k, v, k, v, None, None
+    k_s, v_s = 0.5, 2.0
+    fmax = torch.finfo(kv_dtype).max
+    kq = (k.float() / k_s).clamp(-fmax, fmax).to(kv_dtype)
+    vq = (v.float() / v_s).clamp(-fmax, fmax).to(kv_dtype)
+    scales = [torch.tensor([x], dtype=torch.float32, device=DEVICE) for x in (k_s, v_s)]
+    return kq, vq, kq.float() * k_s, vq.float() * v_s, *scales
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("kv_dtype", FP8_KV)
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("topk", [6, 512])
+def test_sparse_attention_paged(topk: int, kv_dtype):
+    """topk=512 covers the whole history, so it also checks dense equivalence."""
+    torch.manual_seed(0)
+    seq_len, heads, groups, dim = 203, 16, 4, 192
+    shape = (2, seq_len, groups, dim)
+    k = torch.randn(shape, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=DEVICE)
+    v = torch.randn(shape, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=DEVICE)
+    kq, vq, k, v, k_scale, v_scale = _quant_kv(k, v, kv_dtype)
+    # Request 0 starts at a nonzero position to exercise chunked-prefill
+    # addressing independently of the packed query row.

+"""Startup checks for the ROCm Step5 sparse attention layers."""
+
+from vllm.config import KVTransferConfig, VllmConfig

+def verify_kv_transfer_compatibility(vllm_config: VllmConfig) -> None:
+    config = vllm_config.kv_transfer_config
+    if config is None or not config.is_kv_transfer_instance:
+        return
+    configs = [config]
+    if config.kv_connector == "MultiConnector":
+        children = config.kv_connector_extra_config["connectors"]
+        configs = [KVTransferConfig(**child) for child in children]
+    if not all(
+        c.kv_connector == "MooncakeStoreConnector"
+        or (c.kv_connector == "NixlConnector" and c.kv_buffer_device == "cuda")
+        for c in configs
+    ):
+        raise ValueError(
+            "Step5 sparse summaries are only transferred by "
+            "MooncakeStoreConnector, or by NixlConnector with device buffers, "
+            "directly or under a MultiConnector."
+        )
+
+
+def _groups_per_rank(total_groups: int, tp_size: int) -> int:
+    if total_groups % tp_size == 0:
+        return total_groups // tp_size
+    if tp_size % total_groups == 0:
+        return 1
+    raise ValueError(
+        f"Step5 tensor parallel size {tp_size} is incompatible with "
+        f"group count {total_groups}: one must divide the other."
+    )
+
+
+def validate_parallel_geometry(
+    *,
+    total_num_heads: int,
+    total_num_kv_heads: int,
+    indexer_num_heads: int,
+    index_tp_size: int,
+    tp_size: int,
+) -> None:
+    """The indexer scores regions per provider group and attention reads the
+    matching KV group, so both partitions must agree globally and per rank."""
+    if index_tp_size != total_num_kv_heads:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "Step5 sparse provider groups must match attention KV groups: "
+            f"{index_tp_size} != {total_num_kv_heads}"
+        )
+    if indexer_num_heads % index_tp_size:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"{indexer_num_heads} sparse indexer heads do not divide into "
+            f"{index_tp_size} provider groups."
+        )
+    if total_num_heads % tp_size:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"Step5 attention heads ({total_num_heads}) must be divisible by "
+            f"the tensor parallel size ({tp_size})."
+        )

+            "Step5 sparse attention needs 4, 8 or 16 local query heads per KV "
+            f"group (num_heads={total_num_heads}, tp_size={tp_size})."
+        )

+top-k and sparse attention over the paged K/V."""
+
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any, cast
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.compilation.breakable_cudagraph import eager_break_during_capture

+    sparse_decode_attention,
+    sparse_decode_splits,
+)
+from vllm.models.step5.common.ops.sparse_indexer import (
+    pack_summary_pages,
+    select_all_regions,
+    select_regions,
+)
+from vllm.models.step5.common.ops.sparse_indexer_scores import (
+    decode_summary_scores,
+    paged_mqa_logits_sm90,
+)

+    LayerNameType,
+    _resolve_layer_name,
+    direct_register_custom_op,
+)
+from vllm.v1.attention.backends.rocm_attn import RocmAttentionMetadata

+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from vllm.models.step5.amd.model import Step5Attention
+
+
+@eager_break_during_capture
+def step5_csa_attention(
+    hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+    positions: torch.Tensor,
+    query: torch.Tensor,
+    output: torch.Tensor,
+    layer_name: LayerNameType,
+    gate: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    kv_cache_dummy_dep: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+) -> None:
+    del kv_cache_dummy_dep
+    layer: Step5Attention = get_forward_context().no_compile_layers[
+        _resolve_layer_name(layer_name)
+    ]
+    indexer = layer.indexer
+    assert indexer is not None
+    metadata = get_forward_context().attn_metadata
+    if isinstance(metadata, list):
+        metadata = metadata[0]
+    if not isinstance(metadata, dict):
+        # Profiling run: caches are not bound yet; claim the scoring workspace.
+        torch.empty(indexer.workspace_bytes, dtype=torch.uint8, device=output.device)
+        output.zero_()
+        return
+    md = metadata[layer.sparse_summary_cache.layer_name]
+    main_md = metadata[layer.attn.layer_name]
+    assert isinstance(md, Step5CSAMetadata)
+    assert isinstance(main_md, RocmAttentionMetadata)
+    n = md.num_actual_tokens
+    output[n:].zero_()
+    if n == 0:
+        return
+
+    cache = cast(Any, layer.attn.impl).summary_cache
+    ring = layer.csa_tail_ring
+    slots = md.slot_mapping[:n]
+    uniform = md.prefill_groups is None
+    # Without drafts every decode token closes at most its own region, so the
+    # summary update fuses into the indexer kernel.
+    fuse = uniform and indexer.num_speculative_tokens == 0
+    q8, k, z, w = indexer(
+        hidden_states[:n], positions[:n], (cache, ring, slots) if fuse else None
+    )
+    groups = q8.shape[1]
+    rows = n * groups
+
+    kv_cache = layer.attn.kv_cache
+    k_scale = v_scale = None
+    if kv_cache.dtype == torch.uint8:
+        kv_cache = kv_cache.view(current_platform.fp8_dtype())
+        k_scale, v_scale = layer.attn._k_scale, layer.attn._v_scale
+
+    if uniform:
+        # Decode or MTP verify: each request owns max_query_len consecutive rows.
+        query_len = md.max_query_len
+        reqs = n // query_len
+        table = md.block_table[:reqs]
+        if indexer.num_speculative_tokens:
+            cache.update_verify(
+                k, z, slots, md.query_start_loc[: reqs + 1], md.seq_lens[:reqs], ring
+            )
+        capacity = min(indexer.max_regions, table.shape[1] * cache.mean.shape[1])
+        scores, decode = decode_summary_scores(
+            q8,
+            w,
+            cache.mean,
+            table,
+            slots,
+            md.seq_lens[:reqs],
+            capacity,
+            num_sms=indexer.num_sms,
+            row_groups=groups,
+            query_len=query_len,
+        )
+        regions = select_regions(
+            scores,
+            decode.current,
+            indexer.topk,
+            indexer.topk_backend,
+            topk_lengths=decode.topk_lengths,
+            sort=False,
+        )
+        sparse_decode_attention(
+            query[:n].reshape(rows, -1, layer.head_dim),
+            kv_cache,
+            regions,
+            main_md.block_table,
+            decode.positions,
+            decode.active,
+            output[:n].view(rows, -1, layer.head_dim),
+            scale=layer.scaling,
+            query_len=query_len,
+            splits=sparse_decode_splits(rows),
+            k_scale=k_scale,
+            v_scale=v_scale,
+            gate=None if gate is None else gate[:n],
+        )
+        return
+
+    assert md.prefill_groups is not None
+    cache.update_prefill(k, z, md.prefill_groups, md.positions, ring)
+    if md.prefill_indexer is None:
+        # Every earlier region fits in top-k: nothing to score.
+        own = torch.div(md.positions, indexer.region_size, rounding_mode="floor")
+        regions = select_all_regions(
+            own.repeat_interleave(groups) if groups > 1 else own, indexer.topk
+        ).view(n, groups, -1)
+    else:
+        regions = torch.empty(
+            (n, groups, indexer.topk + 1), dtype=torch.int64, device=query.device
+        )
+        packed, _ = pack_summary_pages(
+            cache.mean, md.block_table[: md.num_reqs], md.num_regions
+        )
+        start = 0
+        for chunk in md.prefill_indexer:
+            end = start + chunk.current.numel()
+            for g in range(groups):
+                scores = paged_mqa_logits_sm90(
+                    q=q8[start:end, g].unsqueeze(1),
+                    kv_fused=packed,
+                    weights=w[start:end, g],
+                    seq_lens=chunk.lengths,
+                    block_tables=chunk.block_table,
+                    max_seq_len=md.num_regions,
+                )
+                regions[start:end, g] = select_regions(
+                    scores,
+                    chunk.current,
+                    indexer.topk,
+                    indexer.topk_backend,
+                    topk_lengths=chunk.topk_lengths,
+                    sort=False,
+                )
+            start = end
+    key_cache, value_cache = kv_cache.transpose(1, 2).split(layer.head_dim, dim=-1)
+    sparse_attention_paged(
+        query[:n],
+        key_cache,
+        value_cache,
+        regions,
+        main_md.block_table,
+        md.token_req,
+        md.positions,
+        output[:n],
+        region_size=indexer.region_size,
+        scale=layer.scaling,
+        k_scale=k_scale,
+        v_scale=v_scale,
+    )
+    if gate is not None:
+        output[:n] *= gate[:n].unsqueeze(-1).sigmoid().to(output.dtype)
+
+
+def step5_csa_attention_fake(
+    hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+    positions: torch.Tensor,
+    query: torch.Tensor,
+    output: torch.Tensor,
+    layer_name: LayerNameType,
+    gate: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    kv_cache_dummy_dep: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+) -> None:
+    return
+
+
+direct_register_custom_op(
+    op_name="step5_csa_attention",
+    op_func=step5_csa_attention,
+    mutates_args=["output"],
+    fake_impl=step5_csa_attention_fake,
+)

+        assert sparse is not None
+        self.region_size = sparse.region_block_size
+        self.topk = sparse.topk

+        self.max_uniform_query_len = 1 + (
+            spec.num_speculative_tokens if spec is not None else 0
+        )

+            max_query_len=m.max_query_len,
+            token_req=token_req,

+            head_size=self.proxy_dim,
+            max_position=config.max_position_embeddings,
+            rope_parameters=_rope_parameters(config, layer_idx)
+            | {
+                "partial_rotary_factor": sparse.sparse_indexer_rope_dim / self.proxy_dim
+            },
+        )
+
+        self.native_rope = not self.rotary_emb.enabled()
+        vllm_config = get_current_vllm_config()
+        self.topk_backend = vllm_config.kernel_config.sparse_indexer_topk_backend
+        spec = vllm_config.speculative_config
+        self.num_speculative_tokens = spec.num_speculative_tokens if spec else 0
+        self.max_regions = cdiv(
+            vllm_config.model_config.max_model_len, self.region_size
+        )
+        self.num_sms = current_platform.num_compute_units()
+        # Peak scoring workspace: decode scores or bounded prefill logits, plus
+        # the per-step prefill page table.
+        sched = vllm_config.scheduler_config
+        decode_rows = (
+            sched.max_num_seqs
+            * (1 + self.num_speculative_tokens)
+            * self.num_local_groups
+        )
+        decode_scores = decode_rows * round_up(self.max_regions, 256) * 4
+        prefill_table = sched.max_num_batched_tokens * cdiv(self.max_regions, 128) * 16
+        self.workspace_bytes = (
+            max(envs.VLLM_SPARSE_INDEXER_MAX_LOGITS_MB << 20, decode_scores)
+            + prefill_table
+        )
+
+    def forward(
+        self, hidden_states: torch.Tensor, positions: torch.Tensor, decode=None
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+        """Returns ``(q [T, G, 8, P] fp8, k [T, 1, P], z [T, 1, P],
+        w [T, G, 8])`` for this rank's ``G`` local groups, heads padded to 8.
+
+        With ``decode=(summary cache, ring, slots)`` it also stores each
+        token's open-region row and summarizes the regions it closes.
+        """
+        q, _ = self.sparse_indexer_q(hidden_states)
+        k, _ = self.sparse_indexer_k(hidden_states)
+        z, _ = self.sparse_indexer_z(hidden_states)
+        w, _ = self.sparse_indexer_w(hidden_states)
+        fused = {}
+        if decode is not None:
+            cache, ring, slots = decode
+            fused = dict(
+                decode_cache=cache, decode_ring=ring, decode_z=z, decode_slots=slots
+            )
+        q, k, w = indexer_norm_rope(
+            q,
+            k,
+            w,
+            self.sparse_indexer_q_norm.weight,
+            self.sparse_indexer_k_norm.weight,
+            self.sparse_indexer_k_norm.bias,
+            self.rotary_emb.cos_sin_cache,
+            positions,
+            self.eps,
+            self.zero_centered,
+            native_rope=self.native_rope,
+            num_groups=self.num_local_groups,
+            **fused,
+        )
+        return q, k, z.view(-1, 1, self.proxy_dim), w
+

+def _layer_types(config: Step5Config) -> list[str]:
+    # `layer_types` covers only the dense stack; MTP layers index past it.
+    return config.layer_types_with_mtp or config.layer_types or []

+def _num_attention_heads(config: Step5Config, layer_type: str) -> int:
+    if layer_type == "sliding_attention":
+        if num_heads := getattr(config, "num_sliding_attention_heads", None):
+            return num_heads
+        other = config.attention_other_setting or {}
+        if other.get("attention_type") == layer_type:
+            return other["num_attention_heads"]
+    return config.num_attention_heads

+def _rope_parameters(config: Step5Config, layer_idx: int) -> dict:
+    rope_parameters = dict(_rope_scaling(config, layer_idx) or {})
+    rope_parameters.setdefault("rope_type", "default")
+    theta = config.rope_theta
+    rope_parameters["rope_theta"] = (
+        theta[layer_idx] if isinstance(theta, list) else theta
+    )
+    factors = config.partial_rotary_factors
+    rope_parameters["partial_rotary_factor"] = factors[layer_idx] if factors else 1.0
+    return rope_parameters

+def _is_moe_layer(config: Step5Config, layer_idx: int) -> bool:
+    if (moe_layers := getattr(config, "moe_layers_enum", None)) is not None:
+        return layer_idx in {int(i) for i in moe_layers.strip().split(",")}
+    return 0 < layer_idx < config.num_hidden_layers

+def _swiglu_limit(limits: list | None, layer_idx: int) -> float | None:
+    limit = limits[layer_idx] if limits and layer_idx < len(limits) else None
+    return float(limit) if limit else None

+class Step5MLP(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        config: Step5Config,
+        intermediate_size: int,
+        quant_config,
+        reduce_results: bool,
+        prefix: str,
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.gate_up_proj = MergedColumnParallelLinear(
+            config.hidden_size,
+            [intermediate_size] * 2,
+            bias=False,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.gate_up_proj",
+        )
+        self.down_proj = RowParallelLinear(
+            intermediate_size,
+            config.hidden_size,
+            bias=False,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            reduce_results=reduce_results,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.down_proj",
+        )
+        limit = _swiglu_limit(config.swiglu_limits_shared, extract_layer_index(prefix))
+        self.act_fn = SwigluStepAndMul(limit=limit) if limit else SiluAndMul()
+
+    def forward(self, hidden_states: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        gate_up, _ = self.gate_up_proj(hidden_states)
+        output, _ = self.down_proj(self.act_fn(gate_up))
+        return output

+class Step5MoE(nn.Module):

+        super().__init__()

+            self.n_physical_experts // get_ep_group().device_group.size()
+        )
+        if not (config.use_moe_router_bias and config.need_fp32_gate):
+            raise ValueError("Step5 MoE requires an FP32 gate with a router bias.")

+        self.gate = GateLinear(
+            config.hidden_size,
+            config.moe_num_experts,

+            params_dtype=torch.float32,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.gate",

+            intermediate_size=config.moe_intermediate_size,
+            renormalize=config.norm_expert_weight,

+    def forward(self, hidden_states: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:

+class Step5Attention(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self, vllm_config: VllmConfig, prefix: str) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        config = vllm_config.model_config.hf_config
+        cache_config = vllm_config.cache_config
+        quant_config = vllm_config.quant_config
+        self.layer_idx = extract_layer_index(prefix)
+        layer_type = _layer_types(config)[self.layer_idx]
+        tp_size = get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size()
+        self.total_num_heads = _num_attention_heads(config, layer_type)
+        self.total_num_kv_heads = config.num_attention_groups
+        self.num_heads = self.total_num_heads // tp_size
+        self.num_kv_heads = max(1, self.total_num_kv_heads // tp_size)
+        self.head_dim = getattr(config, "head_dim", None) or (
+            config.hidden_size // self.total_num_heads
+        )
+        self.q_size = self.num_heads * self.head_dim
+        self.kv_size = self.num_kv_heads * self.head_dim
+        self.scaling = self.head_dim**-0.5
+        use_rope_layers = getattr(config, "use_rope_layers", None)
+        self.use_rope = use_rope_layers[self.layer_idx] if use_rope_layers else True
+        self.use_head_wise_attn_gate = getattr(config, "use_head_wise_attn_gate", False)
+
+        self.qkv_proj = QKVParallelLinear(
+            config.hidden_size,
+            self.head_dim,
+            self.total_num_heads,
+            self.total_num_kv_heads,
+            bias=getattr(config, "attention_bias", False),
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.qkv_proj",
+        )
+        self.o_proj = RowParallelLinear(
+            self.total_num_heads * self.head_dim,
+            config.hidden_size,
+            bias=False,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.o_proj",
+        )
+        if self.use_head_wise_attn_gate:
+            self.g_proj = ColumnParallelLinear(
+                config.hidden_size,
+                self.total_num_heads,
+                bias=False,
+                quant_config=quant_config,
+                prefix=f"{prefix}.g_proj",
+            )
+        self.q_norm = GemmaRMSNorm(self.head_dim, config.rms_norm_eps)
+        self.k_norm = GemmaRMSNorm(self.head_dim, config.rms_norm_eps)
+        self.rotary_emb = get_rope(
+            head_size=self.head_dim,
+            max_position=config.max_position_embeddings,
+            rope_parameters=_rope_parameters(config, self.layer_idx),
+        )
+
+        sparse = _is_sparse_layer(config, self.layer_idx)
+        self.attn = Attention(
+            self.num_heads,
+            self.head_dim,
+            self.scaling,
+            num_kv_heads=self.num_kv_heads,
+            cache_config=cache_config,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.attn",
+            per_layer_sliding_window=getattr(config, "sliding_window", None)
+            if layer_type == "sliding_attention"
+            else None,
+            # The CSA kernels read this backend's paged K/V layout.
+            attn_backend=RocmAiterUnifiedAttentionBackend if sparse else None,
+        )
+
+        self.indexer = None
+        if not sparse:
+            return
+        self._validate_sparse(vllm_config)
+        self.indexer = Step5SparseIndexer(config, self.layer_idx, prefix=prefix)
+        static_context = vllm_config.compilation_config.static_forward_context
+        self.sparse_summary_cache = Step5CSASummaryCacheLayer(
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.attn.sparse_summary_cache",
+            target_impl=self.attn.impl,
+            static_forward_context=static_context,
+        )
+        self.csa_tail_ring = Step5CSATailRing(
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.attn.csa_tail_ring",
+            main_layer_name=self.attn.layer_name,
+            num_speculative_tokens=self.indexer.num_speculative_tokens,
+            static_forward_context=static_context,
+        )
+        self.csa_layer_name = f"{prefix}.csa"
+        if self.csa_layer_name in static_context:
+            raise ValueError(f"Duplicate layer name: {self.csa_layer_name}")
+        static_context[self.csa_layer_name] = self
+
+    def _validate_sparse(self, vllm_config: VllmConfig) -> None:
+        cache_dtype = vllm_config.cache_config.cache_dtype
+        if (
+            cache_dtype not in ("fp8", "fp8_e4m3")
+            and kv_cache_dtype_str_to_dtype(cache_dtype, vllm_config.model_config)
+            != torch.bfloat16
+        ):
+            raise NotImplementedError(
+                "Step-5 sparse attention reads a BF16 or FP8 E4M3 KV cache; "
+                f"got {cache_dtype}"
+            )
+        if not self.use_rope:
+            raise NotImplementedError("Step-5 sparse layers require RoPE")
+        if self.head_dim != 192:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"Step-5 sparse attention requires head_dim 192, got {self.head_dim}"
+            )
+        if vllm_config.parallel_config.use_ubatching:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "Step-5 sparse attention does not support dual-batch overlap or "
+                "microbatching yet. Disable --enable-dbo and set --ubatch-size 1."
+            )
+        verify_kv_transfer_compatibility(vllm_config)
+        if rocm_aiter_ops.is_shuffle_kv_cache_enabled() and on_gfx1250():
+            raise NotImplementedError(
+                "Step-5 sparse attention reads the unshuffled KV cache layout."
+            )
+        sparse = get_step5_sparse_config(vllm_config.model_config.hf_config)
+        assert sparse is not None
+        validate_parallel_geometry(
+            total_num_heads=self.total_num_heads,
+            total_num_kv_heads=self.total_num_kv_heads,
+            indexer_num_heads=sparse.sparse_indexer_num_heads,
+            index_tp_size=sparse.index_tp_size,
+            tp_size=get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size(),
+        )
+
+    def forward(
+        self, positions: torch.Tensor, hidden_states: torch.Tensor
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        qkv, _ = self.qkv_proj(hidden_states)
+        q, k, v = qkv.split([self.q_size, self.kv_size, self.kv_size], dim=-1)
+        q = self.q_norm(q.view(-1, self.num_heads, self.head_dim)).view(q.shape)
+        k = self.k_norm(k.view(-1, self.num_kv_heads, self.head_dim)).view(k.shape)
+        if self.use_rope:
+            q, k = self.rotary_emb(positions, q, k)
+        gate = None
+        if self.use_head_wise_attn_gate:
+            gate, _ = self.g_proj(hidden_states)
+        if self.indexer is None:
+            out = self.attn(q, k, v)
+            if gate is not None:
+                out = (
+                    out.view(-1, self.num_heads, self.head_dim)
+                    * gate.unsqueeze(-1).sigmoid()
+                ).view(out.shape)
+            output, _ = self.o_proj(out)
+            return output
+
+        query = q.view(-1, self.num_heads, self.head_dim)
+        k = k.view(-1, self.num_kv_heads, self.head_dim)
+        v = v.view(-1, self.num_kv_heads, self.head_dim)
+        out = torch.empty_like(query)
+        attn_name = _encode_layer_name(self.attn.layer_name)
+        csa_name = _encode_layer_name(self.csa_layer_name)
+        if current_platform.opaque_attention_op():
+            kv_dep = torch.ops.vllm.unified_kv_cache_update(k, v, attn_name)
+            torch.ops.vllm.step5_csa_attention(
+                hidden_states, positions, query, out, csa_name, gate, kv_dep
+            )
+        else:
+            kv_dep = unified_kv_cache_update(k, v, attn_name)
+            step5_csa_attention(
+                hidden_states, positions, query, out, csa_name, gate, kv_dep
+            )
+        output, _ = self.o_proj(out.view(-1, self.q_size))
+        return output
+

+def use_fp32_norm_weights(module: nn.Module, config: Step5Config) -> None:
+    """The checkpoint keeps every RMSNorm weight in ``norm_dtype``."""
+    norm_dtype = (getattr(config, "norm_dtype", None) or "").lower()
+    if norm_dtype not in ("fp32", "float32", "float"):
+        return
+    for norm in module.modules():
+        if isinstance(norm, GemmaRMSNorm):
+            norm.weight.data = norm.weight.data.float()

+class Step5DecoderLayer(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self, vllm_config: VllmConfig, prefix: str = "") -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        config = vllm_config.model_config.hf_config
+        layer_idx = extract_layer_index(prefix)
+        if vllm_config.cache_config is not None:
+            vllm_config.cache_config.sliding_window = None
+        self.self_attn = Step5Attention(vllm_config, prefix=f"{prefix}.self_attn")
+        self.use_moe = _is_moe_layer(config, layer_idx)
+        if self.use_moe:
+            self.moe = Step5MoE(vllm_config, prefix=f"{prefix}.moe")
+        else:
+            self.mlp = Step5MLP(
+                config,
+                config.intermediate_size,
+                vllm_config.quant_config,
+                reduce_results=True,
+                prefix=f"{prefix}.mlp",
+            )
+        self.input_layernorm = GemmaRMSNorm(config.hidden_size, config.rms_norm_eps)
+        self.post_attention_layernorm = GemmaRMSNorm(
+            config.hidden_size, config.rms_norm_eps
+        )
+        self.act_dtype = vllm_config.model_config.dtype
+
+    def forward(
+        self, positions: torch.Tensor, hidden_states: torch.Tensor
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        residual = hidden_states
+        hidden = self.input_layernorm(residual).to(self.act_dtype)
+        residual = residual + self.self_attn(positions, hidden).float()
+        hidden = self.post_attention_layernorm(residual).to(self.act_dtype)
+        ffn = self.moe(hidden) if self.use_moe else self.mlp(hidden)
+        return residual + ffn.float()
+

+_STACKED_PARAMS: tuple[tuple[str, str, str | int], ...] = (
+    ("qkv_proj", "q_proj", "q"),
+    ("qkv_proj", "k_proj", "k"),
+    ("qkv_proj", "v_proj", "v"),
+    ("gate_up_proj", "gate_proj", 0),
+    ("gate_up_proj", "up_proj", 1),
+)
+# The checkpoint packs each MoE projection as one [experts, out, in] tensor.
+_EXPERT_PARAMS = tuple(
+    (f"moe.experts.routed_experts.{param}{suffix}", f"moe.{proj}.{suffix}", shard)
+    for proj, param, shard in (
+        ("gate_proj", "w13_", "w1"),
+        ("up_proj", "w13_", "w3"),
+        ("down_proj", "w2_", "w2"),
+    )
+    for suffix in ("weight_scale_inv", "weight")
+)

+def load_step5_weights(
+    model: nn.Module, weights: Iterable[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]]
+) -> set[str]:
+    params = dict(model.named_parameters())
+    loaded: set[str] = set()
+    for name, weight in weights:
+        for param_name, ckpt_name, shard in _EXPERT_PARAMS:
+            if ckpt_name in name:
+                name = name.replace(ckpt_name, param_name)
+                if is_pp_missing_parameter(name, model):
+                    break
+                param = params[name]
+                for expert_id in range(weight.shape[0]):
+                    param.weight_loader(
+                        param,
+                        weight[expert_id],
+                        name,
+                        shard_id=shard,
+                        expert_id=expert_id,
+                    )
+                loaded.add(name)
+                break
+        else:
+            for param_name, ckpt_name, shard_id in _STACKED_PARAMS:
+                if ckpt_name not in name or ".moe.experts." in name:
+                    continue
+                name = name.replace(ckpt_name, param_name)
+                if is_pp_missing_parameter(name, model):
+                    break
+                if name not in params:
+                    raise ValueError(f"Unsupported Step5 checkpoint tensor: {name}")
+                params[name].weight_loader(params[name], weight, shard_id)
+                loaded.add(name)
+                break
+            else:
+                if is_pp_missing_parameter(name, model):
+                    continue
+                if name not in params:
+                    raise ValueError(f"Unsupported Step5 checkpoint tensor: {name}")
+                param = params[name]
+                getattr(param, "weight_loader", default_weight_loader)(param, weight)
+                loaded.add(name)
+    return loaded

+
+from collections.abc import Iterable
+
+import torch
+from torch import nn

+from vllm.config import VllmConfig
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.layernorm import GemmaRMSNorm
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.logits_processor import LogitsProcessor
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.vocab_parallel_embedding import (
+    ParallelLMHead,
+    VocabParallelEmbedding,
+)

+    is_mtp_completeness_check_enabled,
+)
+from vllm.model_executor.models.interfaces import (
+    MultiModalEmbeddings,
+    SupportsMultiModal,
+    _require_is_multimodal,
+)
+from vllm.model_executor.models.utils import (
+    _merge_multimodal_embeddings,
+    get_draft_quant_config,
+    get_spec_layer_idx_from_weight_name,
+    maybe_prefix,
+)

+    Step5DecoderLayer,
+    Step5ForCausalLM,
+    load_step5_weights,
+    use_fp32_norm_weights,
+)
+
+# Per-MTP-layer weights; everything else in the layer is its decoder block.
+_MTP_LAYER_WEIGHTS = ("embed_tokens", "enorm", "hnorm", "eh_proj", "shared_head")
+
+
+class Step5MTPSharedHead(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self, config, quant_config, prefix: str) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.norm = GemmaRMSNorm(config.hidden_size, config.rms_norm_eps)
+        self.head = ParallelLMHead(
+            config.vocab_size,
+            config.hidden_size,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.head",
+        )
+
+    def forward(self, hidden_states: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        return self.norm(hidden_states)
+
+
+class Step5MultiTokenPredictorLayer(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self, vllm_config: VllmConfig, prefix: str) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        config = vllm_config.model_config.hf_config
+        self.enorm = GemmaRMSNorm(config.hidden_size, config.rms_norm_eps)
+        self.hnorm = GemmaRMSNorm(config.hidden_size, config.rms_norm_eps)
+        self.eh_proj = nn.Linear(config.hidden_size * 2, config.hidden_size, bias=False)
+        self.shared_head = Step5MTPSharedHead(
+            config, vllm_config.quant_config, prefix=f"{prefix}.shared_head"
+        )
+        self.mtp_block = Step5DecoderLayer(vllm_config, prefix=f"{prefix}.mtp_block")
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+        previous_hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+        inputs_embeds: torch.Tensor,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        hidden_states = self.eh_proj(
+            torch.cat(
+                [self.enorm(inputs_embeds), self.hnorm(previous_hidden_states)],
+                dim=-1,
+            )
+        )
+        return self.mtp_block(positions, hidden_states.float()).to(hidden_states.dtype)
+
+
+class Step5MultiTokenPredictor(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self, *, vllm_config: VllmConfig, prefix: str = "") -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        config = vllm_config.model_config.hf_config
+        self.embed_tokens = VocabParallelEmbedding(
+            config.vocab_size, config.hidden_size
+        )
+        self.mtp_start_layer_idx = config.num_hidden_layers
+        self.num_mtp_layers = config.num_nextn_predict_layers
+        self.layers = nn.ModuleDict(
+            {
+                str(idx): Step5MultiTokenPredictorLayer(
+                    vllm_config, f"{prefix}.layers.{idx}"
+                )
+                for idx in range(
+                    self.mtp_start_layer_idx,
+                    self.mtp_start_layer_idx + self.num_mtp_layers,
+                )
+            }
+        )
+        self.logits_processor = LogitsProcessor(config.vocab_size)
+        use_fp32_norm_weights(self, config)
+
+    def _layer(self, spec_step_idx: int) -> Step5MultiTokenPredictorLayer:
+        idx = self.mtp_start_layer_idx + spec_step_idx % self.num_mtp_layers
+        return self.layers[str(idx)]
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        input_ids: torch.Tensor,
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+        previous_hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+        inputs_embeds: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+        spec_step_idx: int = 0,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        if inputs_embeds is None:
+            inputs_embeds = self.embed_tokens(input_ids)
+        return self._layer(spec_step_idx)(
+            positions, previous_hidden_states, inputs_embeds
+        )
+
+    def compute_logits(
+        self, hidden_states: torch.Tensor, spec_step_idx: int = 0
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        head = self._layer(spec_step_idx).shared_head
+        return self.logits_processor(head.head, head(hidden_states))
+
+    def get_top_tokens(
+        self, hidden_states: torch.Tensor, spec_step_idx: int = 0
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        head = self._layer(spec_step_idx).shared_head
+        return self.logits_processor.get_top_tokens(head.head, head(hidden_states))
+
+
+class Step5MTP(nn.Module, SupportsMultiModal):
+    # Each MTP layer's shared_head carries its own LM head weights.
+    has_own_lm_head = True
+    supports_multimodal_embeddings = True
+    packed_modules_mapping = Step5ForCausalLM.packed_modules_mapping
+
+    def __init__(self, *, vllm_config: VllmConfig, prefix: str = "") -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        assert vllm_config.speculative_config is not None
+        draft_quant_config = get_draft_quant_config(vllm_config)
+        vllm_config = vllm_config.with_hf_config(
+            vllm_config.speculative_config.draft_model_config.hf_config
+        )
+        vllm_config.quant_config = draft_quant_config
+        self.config = vllm_config.model_config.hf_config
+        self.model = Step5MultiTokenPredictor(
+            vllm_config=vllm_config, prefix=maybe_prefix(prefix, "model")
+        )
+
+    def embed_input_ids(
+        self,
+        input_ids: torch.Tensor,
+        multimodal_embeddings: MultiModalEmbeddings | None = None,
+        *,
+        is_multimodal: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        inputs_embeds = self._embed_text_input_ids(
+            input_ids, self.model.embed_tokens, is_multimodal=is_multimodal
+        )
+        if not multimodal_embeddings:
+            return inputs_embeds
+        return _merge_multimodal_embeddings(
+            inputs_embeds=inputs_embeds,
+            multimodal_embeddings=multimodal_embeddings,
+            is_multimodal=_require_is_multimodal(is_multimodal),
+        )
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        input_ids: torch.Tensor,
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+        intermediate_tensors: IntermediateTensors | None = None,
+        inputs_embeds: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+        spec_step_idx: int = 0,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        return self.model(
+            input_ids, positions, hidden_states, inputs_embeds, spec_step_idx
+        )
+
+    def compute_logits(
+        self, hidden_states: torch.Tensor, spec_step_idx: int = 0
+    ) -> torch.Tensor | None:
+        return self.model.compute_logits(hidden_states, spec_step_idx)
+
+    def get_top_tokens(
+        self, hidden_states: torch.Tensor, spec_step_idx: int = 0
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        return self.model.get_top_tokens(hidden_states, spec_step_idx)
+
+    def load_weights(self, weights: Iterable[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]]) -> set[str]:
+        def mtp_weights():
+            for name, weight in weights:
+                if name.startswith("model.embed_tokens."):
+                    yield "model." + name.split(".", 1)[1], weight
+                    continue
+                layer = get_spec_layer_idx_from_weight_name(self.config, name)
+                if layer is None:
+                    continue
+                name = name.replace(".transformer.", ".").replace(
+                    "shared_head.output", "shared_head.head"
+                )
+                if not any(w in name for w in _MTP_LAYER_WEIGHTS):
+                    name = name.replace(
+                        f"model.layers.{layer}.", f"model.layers.{layer}.mtp_block."
+                    )
+                yield name, weight
+
+        loaded = {
+            f"model.{name}"
+            for name in load_step5_weights(
+                self.model,
+                (
+                    (name.removeprefix("model."), weight)
+                    for name, weight in mtp_weights()
+                ),
+            )
+        }
+        if is_mtp_completeness_check_enabled():
+            missing = {
+                name
+                for name, _ in self.named_parameters()
+                if not name.endswith(
+                    (".k_scale", ".v_scale", ".q_scale", ".prob_scale")
+                )
+            } - loaded
+            if missing:
+                raise RuntimeError(
+                    f"Step5 MTP checkpoint is missing parameters: {sorted(missing)}"
+                )
+        return loaded

+"""Paged Step-5 CSA kernels; each cache has its own block table and page size."""
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.triton_utils import tl, triton
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _attention_paged_kernel(
+    q_ptr,
+    k_cache_ptr,
+    v_cache_ptr,
+    regions_ptr,
+    block_table_ptr,
+    req_ptr,
+    pos_ptr,
+    out_ptr,
+    k_scale_ptr,
+    v_scale_ptr,
+    scale,
+    stride_q_token,
+    stride_q_head,
+    stride_k_page,
+    stride_k_row,
+    stride_k_head,
+    stride_v_page,
+    stride_v_row,
+    stride_v_head,
+    stride_r_token,
+    stride_r_group,
+    stride_bt,
+    stride_o_token,
+    stride_o_head,
+    HEADS_PER_GROUP: tl.constexpr,
+    HEAD_DIM: tl.constexpr,
+    PAGE_TOKENS: tl.constexpr,
+    REGION_SIZE: tl.constexpr,
+    SLOTS: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_H: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_D: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_S: tl.constexpr,
+    FP8: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    token = tl.program_id(0)
+    group = tl.program_id(1)
+    req = tl.load(req_ptr + token).to(tl.int64)
+    position = tl.load(pos_ptr + token)
+    if FP8:
+        scale = scale * tl.load(k_scale_ptr)
+
+    heads = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_H)
+    dims = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_D)
+    head_ok = heads < HEADS_PER_GROUP
+    dim_ok = dims < HEAD_DIM
+    q = tl.load(
+        q_ptr
+        + token.to(tl.int64) * stride_q_token
+        + (group * HEADS_PER_GROUP + heads)[:, None] * stride_q_head
+        + dims[None, :],
+        mask=head_ok[:, None] & dim_ok[None, :],
+        other=0.0,
+    )
+    row_max = tl.full((BLOCK_H,), float("-inf"), dtype=tl.float32)
+    row_sum = tl.zeros((BLOCK_H,), dtype=tl.float32)
+    acc = tl.zeros((BLOCK_H, BLOCK_D), dtype=tl.float32)
+    in_region = tl.arange(0, REGION_SIZE)
+
+    for base in tl.range(0, SLOTS, BLOCK_S):
+        slots = base + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_S)
+        ids = tl.load(
+            regions_ptr
+            + token.to(tl.int64) * stride_r_token
+            + group * stride_r_group
+            + slots,
+            mask=slots < SLOTS,
+            other=-1,
+        )
+        cols = tl.reshape(
+            ids[:, None] * REGION_SIZE + in_region[None, :], (BLOCK_S * REGION_SIZE,)
+        )
+        live = tl.reshape(
+            (ids[:, None] >= 0) & (in_region[None, :] >= 0), (BLOCK_S * REGION_SIZE,)
+        )
+        live = live & (cols <= position)
+        safe = tl.where(live, cols, 0)
+        page = tl.load(
+            block_table_ptr + req * stride_bt + safe // PAGE_TOKENS,
+            mask=live,
+            other=0,
+        ).to(tl.int64)
+        row = (safe % PAGE_TOKENS).to(tl.int64)
+        kv_mask = live[:, None] & dim_ok[None, :]
+        k = tl.load(
+            k_cache_ptr
+            + page[:, None] * stride_k_page
+            + row[:, None] * stride_k_row
+            + group * stride_k_head
+            + dims[None, :],
+            mask=kv_mask,
+            other=0.0,
+        )
+        v = tl.load(
+            v_cache_ptr
+            + page[:, None] * stride_v_page
+            + row[:, None] * stride_v_row
+            + group * stride_v_head
+            + dims[None, :],
+            mask=kv_mask,
+            other=0.0,
+        )
+        if FP8:
+            k = k.to(q.dtype)
+            v = v.to(q.dtype)
+        s = tl.dot(q, tl.trans(k), out_dtype=tl.float32) * scale
+        s = tl.where(live[None, :], s, float("-inf"))
+        tile_max = tl.maximum(row_max, tl.max(s, axis=1))
+        empty = tile_max == float("-inf")
+        shift = tl.where(empty, 0.0, tile_max)
+        rescale = tl.where(empty, 1.0, tl.exp(row_max - shift))
+        p = tl.exp(s - shift[:, None])
+        row_sum = row_sum * rescale + tl.sum(p, axis=1)
+        acc = acc * rescale[:, None] + tl.dot(p.to(v.dtype), v, out_dtype=tl.float32)
+        row_max = tile_max
+
+    if FP8:
+        acc = acc * tl.load(v_scale_ptr)
+    out = tl.where(row_sum[:, None] > 0, acc / row_sum[:, None], 0.0)
+    tl.store(
+        out_ptr
+        + token.to(tl.int64) * stride_o_token
+        + (group * HEADS_PER_GROUP + heads)[:, None] * stride_o_head
+        + dims[None, :],
+        out.to(out_ptr.dtype.element_ty),
+        mask=head_ok[:, None] & dim_ok[None, :],
+    )
+
+
+def sparse_attention_paged(
+    query: torch.Tensor,
+    key_cache: torch.Tensor,
+    value_cache: torch.Tensor,
+    regions: torch.Tensor,
+    block_table: torch.Tensor,
+    token_req: torch.Tensor,
+    positions: torch.Tensor,
+    output: torch.Tensor,
+    *,
+    region_size: int,
+    scale: float,
+    k_scale: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    v_scale: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+) -> None:
+    """Attention over each query's selected regions of the paged K/V, into
+    ``output``. ``key_cache``/``value_cache`` are ``[pages, page_tokens, kv_heads,
+    head_dim]`` views; ``token_req`` and ``positions`` locate every query row."""
+    tokens, heads, head_dim = query.shape
+    if tokens == 0:
+        return
+    groups = key_cache.shape[2]
+    heads_per_group = heads // groups
+    fp8 = key_cache.dtype in (torch.float8_e4m3fn, torch.float8_e4m3fnuz)
+    assert value_cache.dtype == key_cache.dtype
+    assert not fp8 or (k_scale is not None and v_scale is not None)
+    _attention_paged_kernel[(tokens, groups)](
+        query,
+        key_cache,
+        value_cache,
+        regions,
+        block_table,
+        token_req,
+        positions,
+        output,
+        k_scale,
+        v_scale,
+        scale,
+        query.stride(0),
+        query.stride(1),
+        key_cache.stride(0),
+        key_cache.stride(1),
+        key_cache.stride(2),
+        value_cache.stride(0),
+        value_cache.stride(1),
+        value_cache.stride(2),
+        regions.stride(0),
+        regions.stride(1),
+        block_table.stride(0),
+        output.stride(0),
+        output.stride(1),
+        HEADS_PER_GROUP=heads_per_group,
+        HEAD_DIM=head_dim,
+        PAGE_TOKENS=key_cache.shape[1],
+        REGION_SIZE=region_size,
+        SLOTS=regions.shape[-1],
+        BLOCK_H=max(16, triton.next_power_of_2(heads_per_group)),
+        BLOCK_D=triton.next_power_of_2(head_dim),
+        # 8 regions x 8 tokens x 256 padded dims fits gfx942's 64 KiB LDS.
+        BLOCK_S=8,
+        num_stages=1,
+        FP8=fp8,
+    )

## Validation on gfx950

### GSM8K
| MTP | Strict | Flexible |
|---:|---:|---:|
| No | 96.97% | 97.27% |
| 3 | 96.59% | 97.04% |

### Needle in a Haystack
RULER-style NIAH with 40 samples per task and context length, concurrency 1.
| Benchmark | MTP | 32K | 128K | 256K |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Single-key | No | 100% | 100% | 100% |
| Single-key | 3 | 100% | 100% | 100% |
| Multikey-2 | No | 100% | 100% | 100% |
| Multikey-2 | 3 | 100% | 100% | 100% |
| Multikey-3 | No | 100% | 100% | 100% |
| Multikey-3 | 3 | 100% | 100% | 100% |

The initial MTP multikey-3 run used a 128-token output limit and ended during reasoning, producing empty parsed answers. Raising the output limit to 1,024 tokens produced 100% at every context length. The corrected runs used an explicit 32 GiB KV-cache allocation to leave sufficient long-context scratch headroom.

### GPQA-Diamond
Official 198-question dataset, zero-shot chain-of-thought.

| MTP | Flexible accuracy | Length-truncated responses |
|---:|---:|---:|
| No | 85.86% (170/198) | 17 |
| 3 | 85.35% (169/198) | 20 |
